blindSummary: The country's highest legal floor: a 2023 law limiting local cooperation with federal immigration enforcement (a national first) and legal shields against enforcement actions brought from other states/provinces. Against that, it records the most incidents of any state/province in 2025 (198, per an LGBT advocacy organisation's incident tracker), with hate crime rising dramatically in its largest city, and 34 recorded killings 2008-2025 (4.1 per 100k). Paper protection and street-level volume pull opposite ways.
